parameters.scope: Rational q,C checks are formal algebra. Quadrature uses q=exp(-4 lambda), C=Js^2/lambda.

exact.low_coefficients: A0=J2; A1=J3-3 e J2; A2=J4-4 e J3+[C(3+2q+q^2)+EEprime+5e^2]J2, e=(E+Eprime)/2; J0=J1=0

numerical.scope: Two floating Jacobi quadratures. Analytic bounds cover Taylor/quadrature truncation only; floating roundoff is not interval-certified. No finite-N dynamics is simulated.

scope: Exact ordinary/spectral polynomial and centered-force coefficient identities, plus independent numerical evaluation of c_d and its first two derivatives. This does not prove the charged pinching theorem or substitute for common-J mixed Gram checks.
